editorState: The suffix 'ation' is added at the end of {{definition "verbs" "Verbs are doing words, e.g. 'run' or 'clap'."}} to form {{definition "nouns" "Nouns are the names of things, e.g. 'car' or 'octopus'."}} . This game is all about thinking about what the nouns mean.

The suffix 'ation' is added at the end of {{definition "verbs" "Verbs are doing words, e.g. 'run' or 'clap'."}} to form {{definition "nouns" "Nouns are the names of things, e.g. 'car' or 'octopus'."}} . This game is all about thinking about what the nouns mean.

text: A child koala explaining something to an adult koala.
A child koala explaining something to an adult koala.

Cancellation - something that has been cancelled and will no longer happen, e.g. a bus journey.
Commendation - a piece of formal or official praise.

Desertification - the process of an area of land turning into a desert.
Duration - the length of time something lasts.

Electrification - the process of making something electric, e.g. a railway.
Exhalation - the process of breathing out.
Experimentation - the process of doing an experiment.
Exploitation - the act of treating someone unfairly in order to benefit from their work.

Generalisation - a general statement that can be applied to lots of things based on a specific case.

Hospitalisation - the process of becoming ill or injured in a way that means you have to go into hospital.

Information - facts about something.
Improvisation - the act of making something up on the spot.
Inspiration - the process of being mentally stimulated to do something, especially something creative.

Nationalisation - the process of becoming run by the nation or government.

Objectification - the action of making a person seem less valuable by treating them like an object.
Organisation - an organised group of people who are together for a purpose, e.g. a business. 

Perspiration - another word for sweat.
Prioritisation - the process of deciding which things are more important to do first.

Respiration - the process of gases being used by an animal or plant to create energy.

Starvation - the suffering caused by a serious lack of food.

Temptation - the desire to do something, particularly something wrong or unwise.
Transplantation - the process of moving a plant to a new piece of soil or an organ to a new body, e.g. a kidney transplant.
Transportation - the process of moving something from one place to another.

Valuation - an estimation of how much money something is worth.

How to play:

  1. Roll the two dice below to get two words ending 'ation'.
  2. Player 1 chooses one of the words and explains what it means (you can check the meaning below if you need to).
  3. Player 2 guesses which word they chose.
  4. When Player 2 has guessed the word correctly, they roll that die again to get one new word.
  5. Player 2 now chooses one of the two words for Player 1 to guess.
  6. Repeat!
